captions.zh: AI并没有发明新的商业模式
captions.en: AI did not invent a new business model.

captions.zh: 我们正处在一个被宏大叙事包围的时代
captions.en: We are living in an age surrounded by grand narratives.

captions.zh: 打开任何一篇AI相关的文章
captions.en: Open almost any article about AI,

captions.zh: 几乎都在谈论“颠覆范式”
captions.en: and it is likely talking about paradigm disruption,

captions.zh: “重构产业”
captions.en: industry restructuring,

captions.zh: “开启新时代”
captions.en: or ushering in a new era.

captions.zh: 这些词听起来令人兴奋
captions.en: These words sound exciting,

captions.zh: 但它们掩盖了一个极其朴素的真相
captions.en: but they conceal an extremely simple truth.

captions.zh: 因为AI并没有发明任何新的商业模式
captions.en: Because AI did not invent any new business model.

captions.zh: 它只是在做一件极其古老的事情
captions.en: It is simply doing something extremely old:

captions.zh: 把成本和效率推到极致
captions.en: pushing cost and efficiency to their limits.

captions.zh: 先看看过去二十年
captions.en: First, look back at the past twenty years.

captions.zh: 真正称得上新商业模式的东西是什么
captions.en: What truly counted as a new business model?

captions.zh: 移动互联网带来了按需经济
captions.en: Mobile internet brought the on-demand economy.

captions.zh: Uber和滴滴让闲置的车辆变成了可交易的运力
captions.en: Uber and Didi turned idle vehicles into tradable transport capacity.

captions.zh: Airbnb让空置的房间变成了酒店
captions.en: Airbnb turned empty rooms into hotels.

captions.zh: 它们创造了一种新的供给方式
captions.en: They created a new way to supply services.

captions.zh: SaaS让软件从买断变成了订阅
captions.en: SaaS changed software from a one-time purchase to a subscription.

captions.zh: 企业不再一次性投入巨额的资金部署系统
captions.en: Companies no longer made a huge upfront investment to deploy systems.

captions.zh: 它们改变了软件的交付和付费方式
captions.en: They changed how software was delivered and paid for.

captions.zh: 社交电商则让每个人都能成为分销节点
captions.en: Social commerce lets everyone become a distribution node.

captions.zh: 信任关系变成了交易渠道
captions.en: Trust relationships became transaction channels.

captions.zh: 这些创新有一个共同特征
captions.en: These innovations share one feature.

captions.zh: 它们改变了“谁在提供”和“怎么付费”
captions.en: They changed who provides and how people pay.

captions.zh: 这两个关键问题
captions.en: Those are the two key questions.

captions.zh: 那当下的AI又做了什么
captions.en: So what has AI done today?

captions.zh: 它没有创造新的供给形态
captions.en: It has not created a new form of supply.

captions.zh: 没有发明新的交易方式
captions.en: It has not invented a new way to transact.

captions.zh: 也没有重构价值链上参与者的角色分工
captions.en: Nor has it redefined participants’ roles in the value chain.

captions.zh: 那么它只是在既有的框架里
captions.en: So it is simply operating within the existing framework.

captions.zh: 把原来需要一个人干两个小时的事情
captions.en: Work that used to take one person two hours

captions.zh: 变成机器
captions.en: is handed to a machine

captions.zh: 干两分钟
captions.en: to do in two minutes.

captions.zh: 把原来需要反复试错才能找到的客户
captions.en: Customers once found only through repeated trial and error

captions.zh: 变成了精准到个位数的定向投放
captions.en: become single-digit precision targets.

captions.zh: 这并非是贬低AI的价值
captions.en: This does not belittle the value of AI.

captions.zh: 恰恰相反
captions.en: Quite the opposite.

captions.zh: 这种“只改变效率”的变革
captions.en: This kind of change that only alters efficiency

captions.zh: 历史上每一次都塑造了新的秩序
captions.en: has shaped a new order every time in history.

captions.zh: 集装箱没有发明航运
captions.en: The container did not invent shipping.

captions.zh: 没有发明港口
captions.en: It did not invent ports,

captions.zh: 也没有改变船的动力系统
captions.en: or change how ships are powered.

captions.zh: 它只是把散装货物装进了一个标准化的铁盒子里
captions.en: It simply put loose cargo into a standardized iron box.

captions.zh: 让装卸的效率提升了数十倍
captions.en: Loading and unloading became dozens of times more efficient.

captions.zh: 让运输成本降低了90%以上
captions.en: Transport costs fell by more than 90 percent.

captions.zh: 但是这个只改变效率和成本的发明
captions.en: But this invention changed only efficiency and cost,

captions.zh: 彻底重塑了全球贸易的版图
captions.en: yet completely reshaped global trade.

captions.zh: 它让制造业从发达国家转移到发展中国家
captions.en: It moved manufacturing from developed to developing countries.

captions.zh: 让深圳的小渔村变成了世界工厂
captions.en: It turned Shenzhen’s small fishing village into the world’s factory.

captions.zh: 让全球供应链成为可能
captions.en: It made global supply chains possible.

captions.zh: 航运还是那个航运
captions.en: Shipping was still shipping.

captions.zh: 港口还是那个港口
captions.en: Ports were still ports.

captions.zh: 但成本结构的变化带来了整个经济地理的重现
captions.en: But the change in cost structure caused economic geography to re-emerge.

captions.zh: AI此刻正在做的事情，和当年的集装箱如出一辙
captions.en: What AI is doing now is just like what the container did then.

captions.zh: 以电商广告投放为例
captions.en: Take e-commerce advertising.

captions.zh: 传统模式下
captions.en: Under the traditional model,

captions.zh: 一个商家想找潜在客户
captions.en: a merchant wants to find potential customers.

captions.zh: 需要先设想一个目标人群的画像
captions.en: They first imagine a target audience profile,

captions.zh: 然后向平台购买对应的流量包
captions.en: then buy the corresponding traffic package,

captions.zh: 再根据转化的数据反复调整
captions.en: and repeatedly adjust using conversion data.

captions.zh: 这个流程充满了浪费
captions.en: This process is full of waste.

captions.zh: 行业里有一句话，叫
captions.en: There is a line in the industry that goes:

captions.zh: “我知道我的广告有一半浪费了”
captions.en: I know half of my advertising is wasted,

captions.zh: “但我不知道浪费在哪一半”
captions.en: but I do not know which half.

captions.zh: AI介入后
captions.en: After AI enters,

captions.zh: 投放逻辑从“人工假设”变成了“机器推理”
captions.en: the logic shifts from human assumptions to machine reasoning.

captions.zh: 系统直接理解商品的使用场景
captions.en: The system directly understands the product’s use cases,

captions.zh: 反向寻找意图匹配的用户
captions.en: and searches backward for users with matching intent.

captions.zh: 不再完全依赖商家输入的关键词和人群标签
captions.en: It no longer relies entirely on merchant-entered keywords and audience labels.

captions.zh: 比如一个卖助眠枕头的商家
captions.en: For example, consider a merchant selling sleep pillows.

captions.zh: 不需要告诉系统
captions.en: They do not need to tell the system,

captions.zh: “我的客户是失眠人群”
captions.en: My customers are people with insomnia.

captions.zh: 系统自己就能通过搜索“半夜总醒”
captions.en: The system can use searches like waking up at night,

captions.zh: “睡醒脖子疼”等行为信号
captions.en: or waking with neck pain as behavioral signals,

captions.zh: 找到这些人
captions.en: and find those people.

captions.zh: 这个变化带来的效率提升是惊人的
captions.en: The efficiency gain from this change is remarkable.

captions.zh: 一个商家可以覆盖的人群边界被大幅扩宽
captions.en: A merchant can greatly expand the audience they reach.

captions.zh: 过去因为“搜不到”而被浪费的流量被重新计划
captions.en: Traffic once wasted because it could not be found is replanned.

captions.zh: 广告还是那个广告，投放还是那个投放
captions.en: Advertising is still advertising, and placement is still placement.

captions.zh: 但每一次的曝光和点击背后
captions.en: But behind every impression and click,

captions.zh: 水分的含量被大幅地挤压
captions.en: the waste is squeezed out substantially.

captions.zh: 再把视角拉远一点
captions.en: Now pull the view back a little.

captions.zh: 看一下知识工作领域
captions.en: Look at the field of knowledge work.

captions.zh: 一家咨询公司为一个客户做市场进入策略
captions.en: A consulting firm develops a market-entry strategy for a client.

captions.zh: 传统做法是派一个团队飞过去，花几周的时间
captions.en: Traditionally, a team flies there and spends several weeks,

captions.zh: 访谈、调研、分析，产出一份几百页的报告
captions.en: interviewing, researching, analyzing, and producing a report hundreds of pages long.

captions.zh: 收费从几十万到上百万美元不等
captions.en: Fees range from hundreds of thousands to over a million dollars.

captions.zh: AI介入之后
captions.en: After AI enters,

captions.zh: 一个经过专业调校的模型
captions.en: a professionally tuned model

captions.zh: 可以在几个小时内完成行业扫描
captions.en: can complete an industry scan in a few hours,

captions.zh: 竞品分析
captions.en: competitive analysis,

captions.zh: 消费者的洞察
captions.en: and consumer insight,

captions.zh: 生成一份结构完整、逻辑自洽的报告初稿
captions.en: then generate a structurally complete and coherent first draft.

captions.zh: 咨询顾问的角色
captions.en: The consultant’s role

captions.zh: 从“信息采集和分析者”变成了“策略判断”
captions.en: changes from information collector and analyst to strategy judge

captions.zh: 和“交付把控者”
captions.en: and delivery controller.

captions.zh: 咨询还是那个咨询
captions.en: Consulting is still consulting,

captions.zh: 但交付的效率提升了一个量级
captions.en: but delivery efficiency rises by an order of magnitude,

captions.zh: 人力成本大幅下降
captions.en: and labor costs fall sharply.

captions.zh: 以前从“客户有需求”到“客户交付成果”之间
captions.en: Previously, between a client having a need and a client delivering a result,

captions.zh: 有一长串的信息搬运和模式化的分析工作
captions.en: there was a long chain of information handling and formulaic analysis.

captions.zh: 这部分不产生策略价值
captions.en: This part creates no strategic value,

captions.zh: 但必须有人做
captions.en: but someone has to do it.

captions.zh: AI接手了这一段
captions.en: AI takes over this section,

captions.zh: 把顾问的精力释放到真正需要人类判断的内部
captions.en: freeing the consultant’s energy inside the work that truly needs human judgment.

captions.zh: 这里可能有人会问
captions.en: Someone may ask here:

captions.zh: 如果AI只是改变了效率和成本
captions.en: if AI only changes efficiency and cost,

captions.zh: 那它最终会让所有行业变成卷价格的“红海”吗
captions.en: will it eventually turn every industry into a price-war red ocean?

captions.zh: 这个担忧呢
captions.en: This concern

captions.zh: 是来自一个常见的一个误解
captions.en: comes from a common misunderstanding.

captions.zh: 集装箱并没有让所有的港口收费趋同
captions.en: Containers did not make every port charge the same,

captions.zh: 但让那些能处理更大吞吐量的港口
captions.en: but ports able to handle more throughput

captions.zh: 获得了绝对优势
captions.en: gained an absolute advantage.

captions.zh: AI也一样
captions.en: AI is the same.

captions.zh: 当连接成本趋近于零
captions.en: When connection costs approach zero,

captions.zh: 企业之间的竞争就会从“谁更擅长找到客户”
captions.en: competition shifts away from who is better at finding customers

captions.zh: 变成“谁更擅长理解客户”
captions.en: toward who is better at understanding them.

captions.zh: 这就是效率革命的特征
captions.en: This is the hallmark of an efficiency revolution.

captions.zh: 它让所有人都能低价获得同一种能力
captions.en: It lets everyone obtain the same capability cheaply,

captions.zh: 于是把“做得更好”的要求推到了一个新的维度
captions.en: so the demand to do it better moves to a new dimension.

captions.zh: 那些担心被AI取代的人
captions.en: People worried about being replaced by AI

captions.zh: 和指望靠AI一夜暴富的人
captions.en: and people hoping to get rich overnight with AI

captions.zh: 其实犯了同一个错误
captions.en: are making the same mistake.

captions.zh: 他们都在期待一个全新的秩序从天而降
captions.en: They are both waiting for a whole new order to fall from the sky.

captions.zh: 而事实上，旧的秩序只是在被重新打磨
captions.en: In fact, the old order is merely being polished again.

captions.zh: 水还是水
captions.en: Water is still water.

captions.zh: 不过是流得更快
captions.en: It just flows faster.

captions.zh: 至于水流本身
captions.en: As for the current itself,

captions.zh: 它从来不会在意谁在游泳
captions.en: it never cares who is swimming.

captions.zh: 我是超哥
captions.en: I am Chao.

captions.zh: 在兰州
captions.en: In Lanzhou,

captions.zh: 也在创业
captions.en: also building a business.
